id./param/scenario/cs/b_070_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Y O U C A N S E E M E...?
"N O N E E D T O A S K...
"T H E N Y O U A R E...
"{var:1}, what's wrong? Talking to yourself, how unusual.
"T H I N G S P A S T... R E T U R N T O M E...
"Hey, what! What's happening!?
"Look!! The star!!
"Hey, hey! The star is falling!
"Lord Robert! It's dangerous here! Let's leave at once!
"W-Wait! Just a little more! I can almost read the writing!
"Ca... las... mos...
"Lord Robert! This is the limit! Come quickly!
"N-Now what is it!?
"Nnngh!!
"Now this world is mine...
"That was... the Sword of Shadows?
"The star... has vanished...
"...Was that really Erdwin's Lantern? And what was that monster with the sword?
"What are you saying, Hendrik! That was a savior! A savior saved Gallopolis!
"Now Gallopolis is safe. The kingdom must be relieved.
"I'll go back to Gallopolis first. {var:1}, if you need anything, feel free to visit the palace.
"It vanished, but the star was inscribed with the ancient word Calasmos. What on earth is Calasmos?
"Let's ask the Sultan if Calasmos rings a bell. He might know something."
